findings.finding: The `_positive_int` inventory is incomplete and AC1 is unachievable as written. The plan names only two `_positive_int` definitions (`request.py:24`, `reconcile.py:18`), but a grep sweep for `def _positive_int` finds FOUR under `src/rebar`: a fourth token-identical argparse twin at `src/rebar/_cli/_parsers/advanced/bridge.py:17` (same `(value: str) -> int` signature and same body as the two named sites) that is omitted from both the inventory and Scope, plus a differently-typed variant at `src/rebar/_config_resolvers.py:55` (`(raw: str | None, default: int) -> int`) that is intentionally seam-pinned to remain there (asserted by `tests/unit/test_config_resolver_seam.py:74` in `MOVED_PRIVATE`).
